_comment: English body for notion-ai; generated from the Chinese dossier and official pages, not a literal translation.

axes.model_access: Driven by third-party generative models; Notion does not publish the full provider list or routing details, and features vary by tier and feature flag.
axes.runtime: Runs in Notion’s cloud, with web, desktop and mobile entry points; no model runs locally, and offline mode only edits existing content.
axes.local_files: Can read pages, databases and uploaded attachments in the current workspace; local files must be uploaded to Notion and cannot be scanned directly from the local disk.
axes.background: Writing, summarising and database filling are triggered inside a page; there is no general background agent, and long work stays within the current session.
axes.tools: Integrated with Notion pages, databases, comments, calendar and connectors; Notion MCP can expose workspace content to external agents.
axes.context: Context comes from the current workspace and pages the user can access; cross-team and cross-workspace retrieval is limited by sharing settings.
axes.permissions: Workspace admins control members, guests, connectors and retention; commercial use follows the tier and official terms, and customer content should not be used for training by default.
axes.fit: Fits: teams already using Notion for knowledge bases, project docs and light databases. Does not fit: a general chat entry point or heavyweight spreadsheet calculation.
